name: DN-Splatter
aliases: Depth and Normal Priors for Gaussian Splatting
Depth and Normal Priors for Gaussian Splatting (DN-Splatter)
definition: A depth and normal regularization strategy for 3DGS that addresses photorealistic and geometrically accurate reconstruction of challenging indoor datasets by incorporating sensor depth and normal priors during optimization.
summary: DN-Splatter is a 3D Gaussian Splatting strategy using depth and normal priors with edge-aware loss to improve photorealism and enable direct mesh extraction in textureless regions.
